description: Use this when the user asks where FlareWarden sends alerts besides email: their webhooks and Slack, Discord, Google Chat or Microsoft Teams channels, which events and sites each covers, and whether deliveries are failing. Returns each destination with its host (never the full URL, which often carries a credential), events, sites, active or paused, and delivery health. Owners and admins only. Not for the user's own alert emails: use get_my_notifications.
name: list_webhooks
title: List webhooks and chat alerts
